title: Soil-based zeolite and metal oxide nanomaterial application alters reactive nitrogen losses and lettuce (Lactuca sativa L.) growth
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00526D, Paper
Open Access

Jessica J. Chadwick, Iuliia Mikulska, Aleksandar Radu, Swaroop Chakraborty, Peng Zhang, Sami Ullah, Iseult Lynch
Release of NH4+ ions from ZSM-5-15 zeolite pore spaces enables plant uptake, microbial immobilization and oxidation to nitrate, where the latter process produces N2O gas. Ce0.75Zr0.25O2 NMs transform in the soil, forming ZrCl4 and CeO2.
